# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §102 · ⭐⭐ OWNER RULINGS · THE ALERT CLAIM · CONTENT AS MODULE  *(T567)*
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 102.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐ **Grepped: `already handling` 0 · `taking this` 0 · `content version` 0 ·
`content_id` 0.** ⛔ **Neither the alert claim nor content-as-module exists
anywhere in 101 sections.** *Without the claim, two staff text the same customer
different things and the customer decides you're a mess.*

## 102.1 ⭐ THE RULINGS — RECORDED

| ⭐ Ruling | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Each tenant gets their OWN GO AI EZ number**, not a rotating shared pool | ⭐ **replaced by their 10DLC when approved, then full marketing unlocks** |
| ⭐ **Reactivation = a review request to past customers** | ⛔ *not cold marketing — the risk profile is far lower than I assumed* |
| ⭐ **Reactivation follows quiet hours** | ⭐⭐ **web chat, missed-call and client alerts do NOT** |
| ⭐⭐ **Client alerts have their own schedule** | number · days · name · times · **multiple recipients** |

⭐⭐ **And my §101.6 concern is largely retired by ruling 1.** ⛔ *I assumed a
rotating shared pool where one tenant's complaints poison everyone's number.*
⭐ **A dedicated number per tenant contains the blast radius to that tenant** —
which is both safer and simpler.

⚠️ ⭐ **One thing that survives:** pool numbers still share **our 10DLC brand
registration.** ⭐⭐ *So per-number complaint monitoring stays* — a brand-level
complaint rate is still a shared asset even when the numbers aren't.

---

## 102.2 ⭐⭐⭐ THE ALERT CLAIM — NOBODY HAS SPECCED THIS

⛔ **Three staff get the same missed-call alert. Two reply. The customer receives
two different answers from the same business.**

```
  ⭐ alert fires ──► Dave · Sam · the office all receive it
       │
  ⭐⭐ Dave replies "C" ──► ⭐ HE CLAIMS THE CONVERSATION
       │
       ├─ ⭐⭐ Sam and the office are told: "Dave is handling this"
       ├─ ⛔ their reply codes stop working on that conversation
       └─ ⭐ Dave's name appears on the thread
```

| ⭐ Mechanic | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **The claim lives on the `Conversation`** | ⛔ *not on the alert — §11.5, one thread* |
| ⭐⭐ **First reply wins** | ⭐ **claimed_by · claimed_at, atomic** |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **A claim EXPIRES** | ⛔ *Dave claims it and goes to lunch. **Default 30 min, then it releases and re-alerts*** |
| ⭐ **Release on resolution** | or manually — *"I'm done"* |
| ⭐⭐ **OVERRIDE is explicit** | ⭐ *"Dave is on this — reply `O` to message them anyway"* |
| ⭐ **An override is logged and both are told** | ⛔ *silent overrides recreate the problem* |
| ⭐ **The customer never sees any of it** | one thread, one business |

⭐⭐⭐ **Expiry is the part that's easy to miss and fatal to omit.** ⛔ *A claim
with no timeout means one distracted person silently blocks everyone else, and
the lead dies inside a lock nobody can see.*

⚠️ ⭐ **And the negative test that proves it:** ⭐⭐ **Sam replies after Dave
claimed — assert the refusal code, ⛔ not that zero messages were sent** *(§97.4.1
— the False Negative rule).*

---

## 102.3 ⭐⭐⭐ CONTENT AS A MODULE — THE MISSING HALF

⛔ **§50–§56 planned WHAT content exists. ⭐⭐ Nothing planned how it's versioned,
tested, replaced or measured.** *Content has been treated as files; it needs to be
treated as code.*

### ⭐ EVERY CONTENT ASSET IS AN ADDRESSABLE, VERSIONED RECORD

```
  ⭐⭐ content_id     sms.missed_call.default
     version        7          ⭐ every edit bumps it
     status         DRAFT | ACTIVE | RETIRED
     locale         en-US
     ⭐ variables    {business_name} {caller_first_name}
     ⭐⭐ owner_module X-66
     ⭐ tests        renders · variables resolve · GSM-7 · length · grade ≤6
     ⭐⭐ metrics     sent · replied · booked      ← ⭐ the only score that counts
```

| ⭐ Rule | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Content is data, never a string in a class** | ⛔ *a hardcoded message can't be A/B tested, localised or fixed without a deploy* |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **Every asset has render tests** | ⛔ *an unresolved `{variable}` reaching a customer is the worst content bug there is* |
| ⭐ **SMS assets are encoding-tested** | ⭐⭐ **one em-dash halves the budget** *(§15.3)* |
| ⭐⭐ **Replace without a deploy** | ⭐ **new version → ACTIVE. Old version RETIRED, ⛔ never deleted** |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **Rollback is setting the old version ACTIVE** | ⭐ *one click, no deploy, no risk* |
| ⭐ **Owned by exactly one module** | *(§95 applies to content too)* |

### ⭐⭐ THE AUTOPILOT LOOP — WHERE IT MEETS X-185

⭐ **A content asset can have competing ACTIVE versions:**

```
  ⭐ v7 ACTIVE 70%   ·   ⭐ v8 ACTIVE 30%   (the challenger)
       ▼
  ⭐⭐ measured on BOOKED JOBS, not opens (§40.2)
       ▼
  ⭐ winner takes 100% · loser RETIRED · ⛔ both kept
       ▼
  ⭐⭐ AND the honesty rule holds: "6 vs 4 is not a difference yet" (§40.4)
```

⛔ **Fleet-level learning applies** *(§40.3)*: ⭐⭐ *a challenger that wins across
500 plumbers is promoted as the default for the vertical — ⛔ never silently for
one tenant on four data points.*

### ⭐ UPGRADING THE CONTENT LIBRARY

| ⭐ Change | ⭐⭐ Mechanism |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Fix a typo** | new version → ACTIVE. ⭐ **Seconds, no deploy** |
| **Add a locale** | new row, same `content_id` |
| ⭐ **Add a variable** | ⛔ **version bump + render test, ⭐ old version still renders** |
| ⭐⭐ **Retire an asset** | RETIRED, ⛔ **never deleted** — *a sent message must always resolve to the version that sent it* |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **A tenant edits their own** | ⭐ **forks to a tenant-scoped version; the platform default keeps evolving underneath** |

⭐⭐⭐ **That last row is the one that makes it survivable at scale:** ⛔ *without
forking, a platform-wide improvement silently overwrites a tenant's customisation
— and they find out from a customer.*

## 102.4 ⭐ ON "ONE MASTER PLAN"

⭐⭐ **`GOAIEZ-MASTER-PLAN.md` IS the one file — 848KB, 102 sections, everything
from every chat.** ⛔ *Nothing has been split off.*

⚠️ ⭐ **But at 848KB it exceeds what most models can read in one pass** — ⭐⭐ *Grok
will likely need the tracker plus targeted sections rather than the whole file.*
**The §-numbering exists precisely for that.**

## 102.5 ACCEPTANCE — §102

☐ ⭐ Rulings recorded; ⭐⭐ **§101.6 concern retired — a dedicated number contains the blast radius**
☐ ⚠️ ⭐ **Brand-level complaint monitoring survives**, because the 10DLC brand is still shared
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **The alert claim: on the `Conversation`, first reply wins, ⛔ EXPIRES at 30 min**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Override is explicit, logged, and both parties told** — ⛔ never silent
☐ ⚠️ **Negative test asserts the refusal code**, not zero messages
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Content is versioned data with render tests** — ⛔ never a string in a class
☐ ⭐⭐ **Replace and rollback without a deploy; ⛔ RETIRED never deleted**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Tenant edits FORK** — ⛔ *a platform update must never overwrite their customisation*
☐ ⭐ Autopilot A/B on **booked jobs**, with §40.4's honesty rule intact

**All nine ✅ — §102 COMPLETE.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §105 · ⭐⭐⭐ THE EXPANSION MACHINERY — 90 → 900  *(T570)*
⭐ **Twelve mechanisms. All twelve were at zero.**
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

> **🗄️ HISTORICAL — PRECEDENCE (T667, §0.A):** expansion machinery 90→900 — the mechanisms live on in §95–§98; the plan here is superseded. *Nothing here is deleted (law 10); read §0.A before treating this section as current.*

## 105.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐ **Grepped: `make:module` 0 · `capability discovery` 0 · `instruction log` 0 ·
`content pipeline` 0 · `auto-register` 0 · `900 module` 0.**

⛔⛔ **Everything so far assumes we build 90 modules and stop. ⭐ There is no
mechanism for adding module 91 to a running system — let alone module 900.**

---

## 105.1 ⭐⭐⭐ `php artisan goaiez:make:module` — THE SCAFFOLD

⛔ **A module built by hand at 900 will differ from a module built at 90.**
⭐ **The generator makes drift impossible:**

```
  ⭐ goaiez:make:module X-194 InvoiceReminders --squad=SQ-10 --wave=3
       ▼
  ⭐⭐ GENERATES, ALL ANNOTATED:
     Services/InvoiceReminders/InvoiceReminders.php   @module @visibility public
     Services/InvoiceReminders/{Internal}.php         @visibility internal
     ⭐ actions/invoice-reminders.yaml                 manifest stub
     ⭐⭐ tests/Modules/InvoiceRemindersTest.php        ⛔ WITH A FAILING NEGATIVE TEST
     app/Modules/X-194/README.md                      the six sections, empty
     migration stub                                   @owns_table pre-filled
```

⭐⭐⭐ **The generated test FAILS by default.** ⛔ *A module that ships green
before anyone writes behaviour is how a stub gets marked BUILT — ⭐ this makes
that impossible.*

⭐ **The ID is claimed atomically** *(§88.2 — X-193 is the ceiling)* — ⛔ **no
collisions, ever.**

## 105.2 ⭐⭐⭐ CAPABILITY DISCOVERY — HOW MODULE 400 FINDS MODULE 12

⛔⛔ **At 900 modules, an agent cannot read the other 899.** ⭐ *It doesn't need
to — it needs a searchable index of what exists.*

```
  ⭐⭐ goaiez:find "send a text"
     → C-Sms          sms.send(to, body, purpose): SendResult   ⭐ public
     → X-188          numberpool.resolve(business): PhoneNumber
     ⛔ REQUIRES: consent.decide() first  (§90.1 — no permit, no send)

  ⭐⭐ goaiez:find --emits "job.completed"
     → 8 subscribers. ⭐ Adding a 9th needs no change to the emitter.
```

| ⭐ Rule | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **Search the INDEX, never the codebase** | ⛔ *reading 899 modules is impossible; reading an index of them is instant* |
| ⭐⭐ **Results are signatures + prerequisites** | ⭐ **never bodies** *(§96.3)* |
| ⭐ **Generated from annotations** | *(§96.1)* — ⛔ can't go stale |
| ⭐⭐ **Step ① of every new module** | ⭐ *"what already does this?" before writing a line* |

⭐⭐⭐ **This is what stops module 400 reimplementing module 12** — ⛔ *which is
exactly how a codebase reaches a million lines and half of it is duplicated.*

## 105.3 ⭐⭐⭐ THE INSTRUCTION LOG — EVERY DECISION, QUERYABLE

⛔ **Evidence files are chronological. Nobody will ever open
`launch-sprint-2-retry-evidence.md` to learn why the guard re-reads state.**

```
  ⭐⭐ .agents/state/INSTRUCTIONS.jsonl     ⛔ append-only, one line per action
     { ts, actor: "matt|claude|gemini|antigravity",
       kind: "ruling|prompt|fix|reversal|deferral",
       module: "X-66", summary, ⭐ reason, evidence_file, supersedes }
```

| ⭐ Query | ⭐⭐ Answers |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐ `goaiez:why X-66` | ⭐⭐ **every decision ever made about this module, in order** |
| `goaiez:why --ruling` | every owner ruling, dated |
| ⭐ `goaiez:why --reversal` | ⛔ **what we changed our minds about, and why** |
| `goaiez:why --deferred` | every DEFERRED item still open |

⭐⭐⭐ **Written by the bot at the end of every sprint** — ⛔ **not by you, and never
edited.** ⭐ *A reversal is a new line, not a rewrite.*

⚠️ ⭐ **This is the thing that survives us both.** ⛔ *When my context ends and a
new chat opens, `goaiez:why` is the difference between resuming and re-deriving.*

## 105.4 ⭐⭐ THE CONTENT PIPELINE — END TO END

⛔ **§50–§56 planned what content exists. §102.3 made it versioned. ⭐ Nothing
connected the two.**

```
  ① ⭐ AUTHOR      separate Claude Code project, block schema §50.3
  ② ⭐⭐ VALIDATE   goaiez:content:lint  ⛔ BEFORE it enters the system
                    schema · variables resolve · GSM-7 · grade ≤6 · no [fill-me]
  ③ ⭐ IMPORT      goaiez:content:import --dry-run    ⭐⭐ shows the diff first
  ④ SEED           idempotent by content_id, ⛔ version-bumped never overwritten
  ⑤ ⭐ TEST        render tests run automatically on import
  ⑥ ⭐⭐ ACTIVATE   DRAFT → ACTIVE, ⛔ or 30% as a challenger (§102.3)
  ⑦ ⭐ MEASURE     sent · replied · BOOKED
  ⑧ ⭐⭐ PROMOTE    winner to 100%, loser RETIRED — ⛔ never deleted
```

⭐⭐⭐ **Step ② is the one that matters:** ⛔ *an unresolved `{variable}` reaching a
customer is the worst content bug there is, and the lint catches it before import
rather than after send.*

⭐ **`--dry-run` showing the diff first** — ⛔ *a content import that silently
overwrites 200 tenant-forked assets is unrecoverable.*

## 105.5 ⭐⭐ THE AI THAT KEEPS IMPROVING CONTENT

⭐ **Wired to X-185, which already exists** *(§40)*:

| ⭐ Trigger | ⭐⭐ Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐ An asset underperforms its vertical baseline | ⭐⭐ **generate 2 challengers, run at 15% each** |
| ⭐⭐ A challenger wins on **booked jobs** | promote — ⛔ *never on opens* |
| ⭐ A refusal pattern appears *(§56.4)* | ⭐⭐ **draft the missing FAQ from the actual questions** |
| ⭐⭐ A tenant edits theirs | ⭐ **fork; the platform default keeps evolving underneath** |
| ⭐ A vertical crosses N tenants | ⭐⭐ **promote its winners as that vertical's defaults** |

⛔ **The honesty rule holds** *(§40.4)*: ⭐ *"6 vs 4 is not a difference yet."*
⭐⭐ **And fleet-level learning means tenant #500 inherits every test tenant #1
ever ran.**

## 105.6 ⭐⭐ CROSS-FEATURE INTEGRATION — AUTOMATIC, NOT MANUAL

⛔ **At 900 modules nobody remembers what should connect to what.**

| ⭐ Mechanism | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **A new module SUBSCRIBES; the emitter never changes** | ⭐ *X-194 listens to `job.completed` — X-166 doesn't know it exists* |
| ⭐⭐ **`goaiez:doctor` suggests** | ⭐ *"X-194 emits `invoice.overdue`. 3 modules consume similar events and don't subscribe. Intentional?"* |
| ⭐ **Seams are declared, then TESTED** | ⛔ *check 7 — a seam with no test fails the build* |
| ⭐⭐ **The registry makes every action callable from six surfaces** | ⛔ **automatically, ⭐ with zero integration work** |

⭐⭐⭐ **That last row is the compounding one:** ⛔ *module 900's actions appear in
the API, MCP, the assistant, the canvas, Zapier and the help library the moment
its manifest lands — **no integration turn required.***

## 105.7 ⭐ WHAT 900 ACTUALLY REQUIRES

| ⭐ At 900 modules | ⛔ Only survivable if |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Nobody reads the codebase** | ⭐ **`goaiez:find` + `goaiez:context`** |
| **Nobody remembers decisions** | ⭐⭐ **`goaiez:why`** |
| ⭐ **Nobody hand-writes a module** | ⭐ **`goaiez:make:module`** |
| ⭐⭐ **Nobody checks boundaries manually** | ⭐⭐⭐ **`doctor` in CI** |
| ⭐ **Nobody knows if content works** | ⭐ **measured on booked jobs** |
| ⭐⭐ **Context per task stays under 20k** | ⛔ **or a module splits** *(§95.5)* |

⭐⭐⭐ **Every one is a command, and all six are cheap to build now and impossible
to retrofit at 400.**

## 105.8 ACCEPTANCE — §105

☐ ⛔ **Twelve mechanisms verified at ZERO across 864KB**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **`make:module` scaffolds annotated, ⛔ with a FAILING negative test**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **`goaiez:find` — search the INDEX, never the codebase.** ⛔ *Stops module 400 reimplementing module 12*
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **`INSTRUCTIONS.jsonl` + `goaiez:why` — append-only, queryable, ⭐ survives both models**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Content pipeline in 8 steps; ⛔ lint BEFORE import, ⭐ `--dry-run` shows the diff**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Improvement loop on X-185 — booked jobs, ⛔ never opens; ⭐ tenant edits fork**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **New modules subscribe; emitters never change. ⛔ Zero integration work**
☐ ⭐ Six commands are what 900 requires — ⛔ **cheap now, impossible at 400**

**All eight ✅ — §105 COMPLETE.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §108 · ⛔⛔ PRICING RECONCILED + RC-2  *(T574)*
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 108.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐ **§43.3 and §48A carried invented numbers for 40 turns.** ⛔ *Voice at 7¢ when
the authority says 6¢. AI at $50 when the book says $30. A $250/10k SMS tier that
does not exist. MMS debiting 1 credit when it costs 3.*

## 108.1 ⛔⛔ THE ONE CONFLICT — OWNER OVERRIDES THE BOOK

| ⭐ Item | Price book T552 | ⭐⭐ **Owner, T574** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **AI retail credit** | **$30** *(≈$3.75 real)* | ⭐⭐⭐ **$50 — OWNER WINS** |

⭐ **The book is the authority for everything the owner has not since ruled on.
⛔ Where they conflict, the owner's current word supersedes** — *the book is
T552; this is T574.*

⚠️ ⭐ **Margin note, stated not argued:** ⭐⭐ **$50 retail at 8:1 = $6.25 of real
cost included, up from $3.75.** ⛔ *That is $2.50 more cost per tenant per period
— real at 500 tenants, invisible at 5.*

## 108.2 ⭐⭐ THE LOCKED PRICE BOOK

| | BASIC | FULL |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐ **Monthly · first location** | **$99.99** | **$179.99** |
| **Monthly · additional** | $49.99 | $99.99 |
| ⭐ **Annual · first** | **$497** *(2 payments)* | **$997** *(3 payments)* |
| **Annual · additional** | $297 *(2)* | $497 *(3)* |

⭐ **Annual splits computed to the cent:** `$997 → $332.34 + $332.33 + $332.33`.

### ⭐ INCLUDED — ⛔ identical on both packages, ⭐⭐ PER ACCOUNT not per location

⭐ **500 SMS segments · 1,000 email · ⭐⭐ $50 AI retail credit *(owner T574)*.**
⛔ **Granted at each period boundary; granted credit EXPIRES at the boundary,
purchased credit does not.**

### ⭐⭐ UNITS — the three that were wrong

| ⭐ Unit | ⭐⭐ Rule |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **1 SMS credit** | ⭐⭐ **ONE SEGMENT** *(owner T574)* — ⛔ **GSM-7 = 159 chars; ONE EMOJI forces UCS-2 = 67 chars.** *Charging per message on a 4-segment text bleeds cash instantly* |
| ⭐⭐ **1 MMS** | ⭐ **3 SMS credits** — ⛔ **the code debits 1; that is defect M-228** |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **Voice** | ⭐⭐ **7¢/min, FULL MINUTES** *(owner T586)* — ⭐ *ten 30-second calls are 10 minutes, not 5.* ⛔ **Not 7¢** |
| ⭐ **1 AI credit** | one cent of retail *(our cost × 8)* |
| ⭐⭐ **Undelivered** | ⛔ **still costs its credit** — *the carrier charges us either way.* ⭐ Counts split SENT / DELIVERED |
| ⭐⭐ **"This period"** | ⛔ **30 days, NEVER a calendar month — 12.17 periods/year.** ⭐ *No surface says "month" where it means period* |

### ⭐ METERED

⭐ **SMS $50/1,000** *(⛔ no 10k tier)* · **email $20/1,000** · **AI 8× provider
cost** · ⭐ **email verification 100/mo free, 1,000/$20, 10,000/$100, cached
free** · ⭐⭐ **additional phone number $10/mo — a subscription line, ⛔ never a
credit.**

## 108.3 ⭐ LAW 125 — AGENCY TIER *(new this arc, ⛔ not legacy)*

⭐⭐ **$497/month flat, unlimited tenants. 40% off usage, 25% off voice.**
⛔ **Not in the price book because it did not exist then** — *established this arc
to meet GoHighLevel at their number.*

## 108.4 ⭐⭐ RC-2 — THE FOUR INVERSIONS, AND WHAT THEY CHANGE

| ⛔ I built | ⭐⭐ Matt actually said | ⭐ Modules affected |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐ CAPTCHA on the scrape path | ⭐⭐⭐ **"CAPTCHA IS NOT FOR SCRAPING."** *Scraping retries 3× changing IPs, then moves to the next target.* **CAPTCHA is ONLY for contact forms, so the AI can auto-submit researched proposals** | ⛔ **X-151 FetchEngine** — remove CAPTCHA entirely; add **3-retry IP rotation then skip**. ⭐ **X-109 FormOutreach** — CAPTCHA belongs here, ⭐ *with a free tenant API key that covers most usage* |
| Multiple compliance gates | ⭐⭐⭐ **"No SSN, no credit card, under-18 rejected — THOSE ARE THE ONLY GATES"** | ⭐ **X-156 UniversalIngest · X-132 PersonGraph** — ⛔ **two gates, nothing else.** ⭐ *Everything else ingests* |
| TTL caching of API data | ⭐⭐ **"We don't cache. Even API data goes into OUR DATABASE. Form fills, everything relays back"** | ⛔ **X-151 · X-110 Pixel** — ⭐ **no TTL-and-discard. Every fetch persists as a row we own** |
| Included-software as my idea | ⭐⭐ **"It won't cost anything extra — just SMS, AI voice or normal credit usage"** *(msg 35)* | ⭐ **§30A.1 attributed correctly — ⛔ owner's law, not mine** |

⭐⭐⭐ **The caching correction is the biggest.** ⛔ *A cache is a copy that expires.
A row we own is an asset that compounds* — **and it is what makes the demand index
and the fleet learning possible at all.**

## 108.5 ACCEPTANCE — §108

☐ ⛔ **§43.3 and §48A VOID — replaced by T552 + owner overrides**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **AI credit $50 — owner overrides the book's $30**, margin note recorded
☐ ⭐⭐ **1 SMS credit = ONE SEGMENT** *(owner)* · **MMS = 3** · ⛔ **M-228 logged**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Voice 6¢, rounded up PER CALL** — ⛔ not 7¢
☐ ⭐ **30-day periods, 12.17/year** — ⛔ never "month"
☐ ⭐ **Undelivered still bills; counts split SENT/DELIVERED**
☐ ⭐ **LAW 125 — agency $497 is new-arc law, not legacy**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Four inversions corrected: CAPTCHA · two gates · no caching · attribution**

**All eight ✅ — §108 COMPLETE.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §109 · ⭐⭐ RC-3 — THE FOUR LOST SYSTEMS  *(T575)*
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

> **🗄️ HISTORICAL — PRECEDENCE (T667, §0.A):** RC-3 the four lost systems — detail source only. *Nothing here is deleted (law 10); read §0.A before treating this section as current.*

## 109.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐ **A marketplace that ships executable code is arbitrary code execution inside
a tenant's account.** ⛔ *Every isolation guarantee in §95–§96 assumes we wrote
the code. A plugin store breaks that assumption on day one.*

## 109.1 ⭐ THE OWNER OVERRIDES — RECORDED

| ⭐ Ruling | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **MMS = 1 credit** | ⛔ **M-228 STRUCK.** The codebase was right; the legacy book was wrong |
| ⭐ **AI credit $50** | stands · ~$6.25 COGS accepted |
| ⭐⭐ **CALENDAR MONTH billing** | ⛔ **the 30-day rule is struck** — *fighting Stripe's native monthly engine costs weeks of cron work for nothing* |

⚠️ ⭐ **One number, stated once and then dropped:** ⭐⭐ **an MMS costs a carrier
roughly 3× an SMS.** ⛔ *At 1 credit we absorb ~2 credits per MMS — and **X-189's
name-overlay images make reactivation MMS-heavy by design.*** ⭐ *At 5 MMS per
tenant per period it is nothing; at 500 it is a line item.* **Your call, recorded,
not re-raised.**

⚠️ ⭐ **And calendar month has one live edge case R171 already ruled:** ⭐⭐ *"the
31st is the whole difficulty and not a corner case."* ⛔ **A tenant signing 31
January bills when in February?** ⭐ **R171 says calendar anniversary, no
proration** — the rule exists; ⛔ *the code must implement it deliberately, not
via naive `addMonth()`.*

## 109.2 ⭐⭐ X-194 `GenerativeUI` — ⛔ NOT X-178

⛔ **X-178 AiDesigner builds WEBSITES. This renders the APP ITSELF.**

> ⭐ *"Show me jobs by tech last month"* → ⭐⭐ **a table materialises on screen.**

⭐⭐ **It is a fourth assistant mode.** §14 has OPERATE · CONFIGURE · EXPLAIN —
⭐ **add RENDER.**

| ⛔ Shield constraint | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **It composes from ACTION RESULTS, never SQL** | ⛔ **A generated UI that writes queries is an injection surface.** ⭐ *It calls registered actions (§12), which already carry permissions and the capability gate* |
| ⭐ **Read-only by default** | a write needs the gate, like any action |
| ⭐ **Rendered view is ephemeral** | ⭐⭐ **saveable as a named view = a config row, ⛔ never generated code** |

## 109.3 ⭐⭐⭐ X-195 `Marketplace` — ⛔ TEMPLATES YES, CODE NEVER

⭐ **Two very different things were merged under one name:**

| | ⭐ Risk | ⭐⭐ Ruling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐ **Template / snapshot sharing** | ⭐ **low — it is DATA** *(§47.1 already builds it)* | ⭐⭐ **YES** |
| ⛔ **Executable plugins** | ⛔⛔ **arbitrary code in a tenant's account** | ⛔ **NEVER** |

> ⭐⭐⭐ **A "plugin" is a MANIFEST of registered actions plus config. ⛔ Never
> code.**

⭐⭐ **That makes the isolation boundary the action registry itself** — ⭐ *which
already has permissions, reversal classes and a gate.* ⛔ **A shared template that
tries to reach another tenant's data fails the same check any module would.**

⭐ **Agencies publish · other agencies install · ⭐⭐ every installed action is
still gated per tenant.**

## 109.4 ⭐⭐ X-196 `ChromeExtension` + Gro Node

⭐ **The extension is the TRIGGER. ⛔ The server does the work.**

| ⭐ Rule | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **Scoped, short-lived token** | ⛔ **never a long-lived session cookie** *(Gemini's constraint, correct)* |
| ⭐⭐ **The extension holds NO tenant data** | ⭐ *it sends a signal and a URL; results land server-side* |
| ⭐ **Results write to our database** | ⭐⭐ **per the no-caching law (§108.4)** |
| ⭐ **Gro Node does the deep fetch** | server-side, ⛔ **the 3-retry IP rotation, no CAPTCHA** *(§108.4)* |
| ⚠️ ⭐ **Client-side means AUTHENTICATED scraping** | ⭐⭐ **the operator's own logged-in sessions — a genuinely different capability from server-side, and more powerful** |

## 109.5 ⭐⭐ X-197 `VoiceSelfHosted` — ⭐ THE ECONOMICS

⭐ **Matt, message [25]:** *"LiveKit, our own LLM/TTS/STT or a combination —
Deepgram, Grok, other low-cost APIs. **Cheapest as the default list.** Then the
other format is LiveKit + LLM + STT + TTS **self-hosted**."*

| ⭐ Format | Stack | ⭐⭐ Cost/min |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐ **Default** | LiveKit + cheapest managed *(Deepgram · Groq · Kokoro)* | ⚠️ **~4–5¢ estimated, ⛔ never measured** |
| ⭐⭐ **Second** | ⭐ **fully self-hosted** | ⭐⭐ **~1–2¢ at volume** |

⛔⛔ **This is why 6¢ works.** ⭐ *At 5¢ managed, 6¢ retail is a 17% margin. At
2¢ self-hosted it is 67%.* ⭐⭐ **The second format is not a nice-to-have — it is
the voice product's margin.**

## 109.6 ⭐ THE CALLBACK WORTH NOTING

⭐⭐ **Antigravity minted X-194 through X-197 unprompted, and I called it
unauthorised.** ⭐ **The numbers were right** *(§88.2: X-193 is the ceiling, next
is X-194)*. ⛔ **The process was wrong — no warden, and X-196 depended on a fenced
module.**

⭐⭐ **Now they are properly minted:** X-194 GenerativeUI · X-195 Marketplace ·
X-196 ChromeExtension · X-197 VoiceSelfHosted. ⭐ **Ceiling moves to X-197.**

## 109.7 ACCEPTANCE — §109

☐ ⛔ **M-228 struck · calendar-month billing · AI $50** — owner rulings recorded
☐ ⚠️ ⭐ **MMS cost note and R171's 31st-of-the-month edge case stated once**
☐ ⭐⭐ **X-194 GenerativeUI = a fourth assistant mode (RENDER)** — ⛔ **actions, never SQL**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **X-195: templates YES, executable plugins NEVER** — ⭐ **a plugin is a manifest**
☐ ⭐⭐ **X-196: scoped short-lived token, ⛔ extension holds no data**
☐ ⭐⭐ **X-197 self-hosted voice IS the margin** — ⛔ 6¢ only works because of it
☐ ⭐ **Ceiling X-193 → X-197**

**All seven ✅ — §109 COMPLETE.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §110 · ⭐⭐ TEMPLATE SEVERANCE — THE SITE IS THEIRS  *(owner, T576)*
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 110.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⛔⛔ **If a site is fully severed, a security fix never reaches it.** ⭐ *That is
the WordPress problem exactly — 200 forked sites, one XSS in a block, and no way
to patch any of them.* ⛔ **Severance has to cut design, not runtime.**

## 110.1 ⭐ THE RULING

> ⭐⭐ **A tenant's site is FORKED at selection. ⛔ The template library never
> touches it again.** ⭐ *They have their own space and their own hosting.*

| ⭐ Rule | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Selection COPIES** | ⛔ *it does not reference.* The blocks become theirs |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **Library updates NEVER reach a live site** | ⛔ *a platform improvement must never rewrite someone's page* |
| ⭐ **The designer is dormant** | ⭐⭐ **until the tenant opens it** |
| ⭐ **Their own hosting** | own domain · own SSL · isolated *(X-157)* |
| ⭐ **They may re-pick a template** | ⭐⭐ **an explicit act that forks again** |

## 110.2 ⭐⭐⭐ THE SPLIT THAT MAKES IT SAFE

> ⭐⭐ **DESIGN forks. RUNTIME does not.**

| ⭐ FORKED — theirs, frozen | ⭐⭐ SHARED — always current |
| :--- | :--- |
| Blocks, layout, order | ⭐ **the block RENDERER** |
| Copy, headlines, prices | ⭐⭐ **the pixel · chat widget · form handler** |
| Images, colours, fonts | ⭐ **SSL · CDN · security patches** |
| Their structure | ⭐⭐ **schema output · SEO plumbing · DNI** |

⭐⭐⭐ **So a security fix in the renderer reaches all 200 sites instantly — ⛔ and
not one of them looks different the next morning.**

⛔ **Without this split you get the WordPress trap:** ⭐ *thousands of forked
sites, a vulnerability in a shared block, and no patch path.*

## 110.3 ⭐⭐⭐ THE AI ALWAYS IMPROVES THE SITE  *(owner, T577)*

> ⭐⭐ **The optimisation loop runs ALWAYS. ⛔ It is not opt-in and it is not an
> exception.** ⭐ *The site is severed from the LIBRARY, never from the
> intelligence.*

| ⭐ Always on | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **X-185 tests and improves continuously** | ⛔ *no toggle, no setup, no decision asked of the tenant* |
| ⭐ **Measured on BOOKED JOBS** *(§40.2)* | ⛔ never opens, never clicks |
| ⭐⭐ **§40.4's honesty rule holds** | ⛔ *"6 vs 4 is not a difference yet"* |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **Fleet learning applies** | ⭐ **what wins across 500 plumbers improves tenant #501 on day one** |

### ⭐ WHAT IT MAY CHANGE — and what it never touches

| ⭐⭐ IMPROVES | ⛔ NEVER TOUCHES |
| :--- | :--- |
| Headlines, CTA wording | ⛔ **their prices** |
| Block order, layout | ⛔ **their service descriptions** |
| Image selection | ⛔ **their brand, name or logo** |
| Section emphasis | ⛔ **anything they edited by hand** |

⭐⭐⭐ **That last row is the rule that makes always-on safe:** ⛔ *a tenant edit
FREEZES that element.* ⭐ **The AI improves what they have not claimed; the moment
they touch something, it is theirs and the loop leaves it alone.**

### ⭐ VISIBLE, NEVER SILENT

☐ ⭐⭐ **Every change is an `ActionInvocation`** — ⭐ EXPLAIN answers *"why does my
page look different?"*
☐ ⭐ **The weekly card shows what changed and why** — *"moved reviews above the
fold; that version booked 4 more jobs"*
☐ ⭐⭐ **One tap reverts and FREEZES it** — ⛔ *a revert is a claim; the loop never
retries that element*
☐ ⭐ **Previous versions kept, ⛔ never deleted**

⭐⭐ **So it improves by default and yields permanently on contact.** ⛔ *An
always-on system that ignores a revert is a system nobody trusts twice.*

## 110.4 ⭐ WHAT STAYS WIRED REGARDLESS

⛔ **Severance never disconnects the platform.** ⭐ **The full-stack site law
(§26.2) holds on a forked site:** ⭐⭐ **pixel · chat AI · form capture · DNI ·
SEO write-back · SSL** — *all live, all current, ⛔ none of it forked.*

⭐ *A tenant severed from the template library is still a tenant. **Their design
is frozen; their platform is not.***

## 110.5 ACCEPTANCE — §110

☐ ⭐⭐ **Selection COPIES; ⛔ library updates never reach a live site**
☐ ⭐ Designer dormant until opened; re-picking is an explicit re-fork
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **DESIGN forks, RUNTIME does not** — ⛔ *the WordPress trap, avoided*
☐ ⭐ A renderer security fix reaches every site, ⛔ **changing none of them**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **AI optimisation is ALWAYS ON** — ⛔ not opt-in · measured elements only · logged · ⭐ **a revert FREEZES that element permanently**
☐ ⛔ **Never their prices, service copy or brand**
☐ ⭐ Pixel, chat, forms, DNI, SEO and SSL stay live and current on a forked site

**All seven ✅ — §110 COMPLETE.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §113 · ⭐⭐ TURN 5 — THE MODULE GATE  *(T580)*
⭐ **What stops 900 modules becoming 900 duplicates.**
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 113.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐ **A semantic index built on embeddings goes stale the moment code changes and
nobody notices** — ⛔ *it returns confident answers about methods that were
renamed last week.* ⭐⭐ **So `find` indexes ANNOTATIONS, which are generated on
every commit** *(§96.1)*, ⛔ **never a vector store nobody re-builds.**

## 113.1 ⭐ P11 + P18 → THE GAP LEDGER

☐ ⛔⛔ **P11 — untracked links.** *Only booking links ride `shortLinkFor()`.
R14 is not true in code. **X-138 is structurally blind.*** → ⭐ **Wave 1, blocking**
☐ ⚠️ **P18 — Inbox scope unverified.** ⭐ `Account\Inbox.php` exists; is it §58's
unified thread? → **Wave 1, one `cat`**
☐ ⭐ **Check 11 runs as a pre-commit hook + CI merge gate** — ⛔ *never blocking a
local TDD loop* *(Gemini, T580)*

## 113.2 ⭐⭐⭐ `goaiez:find "{intent}"`

⭐ **Three layers, cheapest first. ⛔ No embeddings.**

```
  ⭐ ① EXACT       action id · module name · @provides    (instant)
  ⭐ ② KEYWORD     @provides · @emits · README "what it does"
  ⭐⭐ ③ SYNONYM    a hand-kept map: "text"→sms · "call"→voice ·
                   "remind"→campaign · "charge"→billing
```

⭐⭐ **Layer ③ is thirty lines of config, not a model.** ⛔ *It is also the only
layer that can be wrong, so it is visible and editable.*

### ⭐ THE OUTPUT — ⛔ signature, module, and PREREQUISITES

```
  ⭐ goaiez:find "send a text"

  ⭐⭐ C-Sms  ·  sms.send(to, body, purpose): SendResult      @visibility public
     ⛔ REQUIRES  consent.decide() → SendPermit   (§90.1 — no permit, no send)
     ⛔ REQUIRES  numberpool.resolve(business)    (§43.1)
     ⭐ DEBITS    1 SMS credit per SEGMENT        (§108.2)
     ⭐ EMITS     message.sent · message.failed

  ⭐ X-188 · numberpool.resolve(business): PhoneNumber        @visibility public
```

⭐⭐⭐ **`REQUIRES` is what makes it a gate rather than a search box.** ⛔ *An
agent that finds `sms.send` and calls it without a permit writes a compliance
breach — the index tells it before it writes a line.*

⭐ **Flags:** `--emits "job.completed"` *(who subscribes)* · `--owns-table
price_book_items` *(who owns it)* · ⭐⭐ `--similar X-194` *(⛔ before minting
anything new)*.

## 113.3 ⭐⭐ `goaiez:make:module X-198 InvoiceReminders`

### ⭐ WHAT IT GENERATES

```
  app/Services/InvoiceReminders/InvoiceReminders.php     @module @visibility public
  app/Services/InvoiceReminders/ReminderSchedule.php     @visibility internal
  actions/invoice-reminders.yaml                          manifest stub
  ⭐⭐ tests/Modules/InvoiceRemindersTest.php               ⛔ FAILS BY DEFAULT
  app/Modules/X-198/README.md                             six sections, empty
  database/migrations/..._create_invoice_reminders.php    @owns_table pre-filled
```

### ⭐⭐⭐ THE FAILING TEST — the exact shape

```php
/** */
public function test_module_is_implemented(): void
{
    ⭐ $this->markTestIncomplete(
        'X-198 InvoiceReminders is scaffolded, not built. '
        .⛔ 'Replace this test with real contract assertions. '
        .'Until then BUILD-STATE cannot leave BUILDING.'
    );
}
```

⛔ **`markTestIncomplete` — ⭐ not a failure.** *A red suite trains people to
ignore red.* ⭐⭐ **An INCOMPLETE test is visible, honest, and `doctor` reads it
as "not built."**

### ⭐⭐ THE STATE LOCK

| ⭐ Step | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐ `make:module` writes | ⭐⭐ **`status: BUILDING` + `scaffold: true`** |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **`doctor` refuses BUILT while `scaffold: true`** | ⛔ *and the flag clears ONLY when no `markTestIncomplete` remains in that module's tests* |
| ⭐ **VERIFIED additionally needs** | a prover *(§61)* + ⭐ **an `INSTRUCTIONS.jsonl` line** *(check 11)* |

⭐⭐⭐ **So a module cannot lie about being built** — ⛔ *the scaffold flag is
cleared by removing the placeholder, which is the same act as writing the real
test.*

## 113.4 ⭐⭐ THE COLLISION CHECK — ⛔ FAIL LOUDLY

```
  ⭐ make:module X-198 …
       ├─ ⛔ X-198 in BUILD-STATE?        → FAIL "already exists, status BUILT"
       ├─ ⛔ X-198 in the retired list?   → FAIL "retired T550, never reuse"
       ├─ ⛔ name already used?           → FAIL "InvoiceReminders is X-91"
       ├─ ⚠️ goaiez:find --similar hit?   → ⭐⭐ WARN + require --force
       └─ ⭐ else → mint, ceiling += 1
```

⭐⭐ **The `--similar` warning is the anti-duplication gate.** ⛔ *Minting
`InvoiceReminders` when `X-91 PaymentChasing` already emits `invoice.overdue` is
exactly how 900 modules become 900 duplicates.*

⭐ **`--force` is allowed** — ⭐⭐ **and writes an `INSTRUCTIONS.jsonl` line with
the reason.** ⛔ *An override you can see is fine; one you cannot is how the rule
dies.*

## 113.5 ⭐ THE ID IS CLAIMED ATOMICALLY

⛔ **Sixty agents minting at once must not collide** *(the X-157 lesson)*.
⭐⭐ **`make:module` takes a lock on `BUILD-STATE.json`, reads the ceiling, writes
the row, releases.** ⭐ *A second agent asking simultaneously gets the next number,
never the same one.*

## 113.6 ACCEPTANCE — §113

☐ ⭐ P11 and P18 logged to the Gap Ledger; ⭐ **check 11 = pre-commit + CI**
☐ ⭐⭐ **`find` is three layers, ⛔ no embeddings** — synonyms are 30 lines of visible config
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Output carries PREREQUISITES** — *the index tells an agent about the permit before it writes code*

## 116.1 ⭐⭐⭐ EXPAND / MIGRATE / CONTRACT — ⛔ NEVER DROP A COLUMN

```
  ⭐ DEPLOY 1 · EXPAND      add the new column, nullable. ⛔ Nothing reads it
  ⭐ DEPLOY 2 · MIGRATE     backfill · DUAL-WRITE both columns · reads switch
  ⭐⭐ DEPLOY 3 · CONTRACT   ⛔ drop the old column — ONLY after deploy 2 is
                            proven in production for ≥7 days
```

| ⭐ Enforced by | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **A migration containing `dropColumn` or `renameColumn` FAILS `doctor`** | ⛔ **unless it carries `@contract-of: <migration-name>` naming the expand that preceded it** |
| ⭐ **`down()` is mandatory and tested** | ⛔ *an untested rollback is a hope* |
| ⭐⭐ **Deploy 3 checks the clock** | ⛔ **refuses if the expand landed <7 days ago** |
| ⭐ **Never expand and contract in one PR** | ⭐⭐ *that is a rename wearing three hats* |

⭐⭐ **The `@contract-of` annotation is the whole mechanism.** ⛔ *An agent cannot
drop a column it did not first add — the annotation must point at a real,
already-deployed migration.*

## 116.2 ⭐⭐ POINT-IN-TIME RECOVERY

| ⭐ Layer | Interval | ⭐⭐ Retains |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **WAL streaming** | ⭐ **continuous** | ⭐⭐ **any second in the last 7 days** |
| **Nightly full** | 02:00 | 30 days |
| ⭐ **Weekly full, off-site** | Sunday | ⭐ **12 months** |
| ⭐⭐ **Pre-deploy snapshot** | ⛔ **every deploy, automatic** | 14 days |

⭐ **`goaiez:restore --to "2026-08-25 14:22:00" --dry-run`** — ⭐⭐ **reports what
would change, ⛔ restores nothing.** Without `--dry-run` it demands the timestamp
typed twice.

☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **A restore is REHEARSED monthly to a scratch database** — ⛔ **an
untested backup is a rumour**
☐ ⭐ **Tenant-scoped restore** — ⭐⭐ *one tenant's data to a point in time,
⛔ without touching the other 499*
☐ ⭐ **Recordings and media in versioned object storage**, ⛔ never only in the DB

⭐⭐ **The pre-deploy snapshot is the one that matters most** — ⛔ *it is the
difference between "roll back the code" and "roll back the code AND the schema
change it made."*

## 116.3 ⭐⭐⭐ `goaiez:halt --outbound` — ⛔ WHERE IT CUTS

> ⭐⭐ **It severs at the DRIVER, not the bus.** ⛔ *Cutting the event bus would
> stop inbound processing — that is an outage, not a safety measure.*

```
  ⭐ inbound webhook → event bus → agent → ⭐⭐ SendDriver ← ⛔ HALT CUTS HERE
                                                    │
       ⭐ everything upstream keeps running: calls answered, texts received,
          conversations threaded, ⛔ sends QUEUED not dropped
```

| ⭐ Scope | Cuts |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **`--all`** | every outbound send, platform-wide |
| ⭐ **`--tenant=X`** | one tenant |
| ⭐ **`--content={id}`** | ⭐⭐ **one bad asset, everywhere** |
| ⭐ **`--channel=sms`** | one channel |

☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **INBOUND NEVER STOPS** — ⛔ *a halted platform still answers the phone*
☐ ⭐⭐ **Sends QUEUE, they do not fail** — ⭐ *resume replays them in order*
☐ ⭐ **`account`-class notifications are EXEMPT** — ⛔ *dunning still gets through*
☐ ⭐⭐ **A halt is an `ActionInvocation`** — who, when, why, ⛔ **reason mandatory**
☐ ⭐ **`goaiez:halt --status`** shows what is halted and for how long
☐ ⚠️ ⭐ **An auto-halt trigger** — ⭐⭐ *complaint rate, bounce spike or cost
ceiling breached halts automatically and alerts.* ⛔ *A kill switch nobody is
awake to pull is decoration*

⭐⭐ **That last one is the difference between a manual switch and a safety
system.**

## 116.4 ⭐ AGENT PRODUCTION ACCESS — ⛔ THE ABSOLUTE

☐ ⛔⛔ **NO AGENT HAS PRODUCTION CREDENTIALS.** ⭐ *Not read, not write*
☐ ⭐ **Agents work on branches; CI deploys** — ⛔ **`doctor` green or no merge**
☐ ⭐⭐ **No agent may run `migrate`, `tinker` or any destructive command against
live** — ⛔ *~250 migrations were deleted in a routine prompt*
☐ ⭐ **A production incident is a human with a runbook** *(D9)*

## 116.5 ACCEPTANCE — §116

☐ ⛔ **§115 corrected — ⭐ five "absences" were grep failures; 73 turns rejected**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Lesson recorded: grep by ARCHITECTURE, ⛔ never by phrase**
☐ ⭐ The 905 register is ⭐⭐ **one script, not 21 turns**

☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Restore rehearsed monthly** — ⛔ *an untested backup is a rumour*
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Halt cuts at the DRIVER — ⛔ inbound never stops, sends QUEUE**

## 118.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

"spine", which is why it stayed thin.*

> X-126 and X-128 have NO wizard and NO tenant autopilot.**

self-retrying* — ⭐⭐ **and the tenant never knows they exist.**

& Caching** *(Redis on high-read tables)* · **Global Update Propagation**
*(a rebrand retro-updates every reference)* · ⭐ **Omni-Channel Inbox Sync** —

the core with HTTP response logic.* ⭐ **→ BACKLOG, assigned to `X-111
OperatorConsole` at M20.** *(Gemini's catch, and my own least-confident flag.)*

**② WIZARD** ⛔ none — internal

## 119.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐ **An assistant that hallucinates capability is worse than one that refuses.**
⛔ *A tenant who is told "done" and finds it wasn't stops trusting every answer
after it — including the true ones.*

⭐⭐ **This is the layer the tenant actually TOUCHES.** ⛔ *M1 was invisible
plumbing. If M2 is wrong, nothing downstream matters, because nobody reaches it.*

## 119.1 ⭐⭐⭐ X-124 `OmniAssistant` — FIVE MODES

| Mode | ⭐ Does | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **OPERATE** | acts | *"text everyone who called last week"* |
| ⭐ **CONFIGURE** | ⭐⭐ **changes platform behaviour by asking** | *"ask for a review after every job"* |
| **EXPLAIN** | reads `ActionInvocation` | *"why did my page change?"* |
| ⭐ **RENDER** | materialises a view *(X-194)* | *"show me jobs by tech"* |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **RECOMMEND** | ⛔ **unprompted** | *"14 missed calls, no text-back template — turn it on?"* |

**① CAPABILITIES FOLDED — 14**
⭐ **Natural Language Routing** · **Assistant Proactive Outreach** · ⭐⭐
**Assistant Multi-Lingual Auto-Detect** — *answers in the language it was
addressed in* · **Base Prompt Engine** · **Pre-Trained Agent Prompts** ·
**Contextual Drafts** · ⭐ **Action Item Extraction** *(reads a transcript, writes
CRM tasks)* · **Intent Matching** · **Reply Classification** · ⭐ **In-App Support
AI** · **Interactive SOPs** · **Global Search** *(inherited from X-121's strip —
⭐ conversational search, ⛔ not a schema feature)* · **Multi-Modal Agent
Handoff** · ⭐ **Prompt Caching & RAG Acceleration**.

**② WIZARD** ⛔ **none — ⭐⭐ the assistant IS the wizard.** *§17.4: every field it
cannot infer is a defect, not a question*
**③ AUTOPILOT** `ladder: L1 → L2, earned` *(2026-08-27 — X-124 PROPOSES; execution rides the underlying action's OWN ladder, never X-124's)* ⭐⭐ **RECOMMEND runs continuously** — ⛔ *it does not wait to be
asked*
**④ EMITS** `assistant.acted` · `assistant.refused` · `assistant.recommended`
**④ CONSUMES** ⭐ **every module's `@provides`** — *via the registry, ⛔ never
directly*
**⑤ AI-CORE** ⭐⭐⭐ **this IS the AI core's surface**

### ⭐⭐⭐ 119.1.1 THE COMPLETENESS MODEL — what powers RECOMMEND

> ⭐⭐ **Every module reports what it NEEDS and what it HAS. ⛔ The gap IS the
> recommendation.**

```
  ⭐ C-Reviews    needs: public_threshold ✅ · ticket recipient ⛔
  ⭐ X-163        needs: callout_fee ⛔ · one confirmed price ⛔
  ⭐ X-66         needs: greeting ✅ · service area ✅ · hours ⛔
       ▼
  ⭐⭐ "Your callout fee isn't confirmed, so I'm refusing to quote it.
      Two taps and I can." ← ⛔ ranked by REVENUE IMPACT, never by module order
```

⭐ **Ranked by what it costs them, ⛔ not by what is easiest to fix.**

### ⛔ 119.1.2 IT MUST KNOW WHAT IT CANNOT DO

⭐⭐ **If an action is not in the registry: *"I can't do that yet."*** ⛔ **Never an
attempt, never a plausible-sounding almost.**
☐ ⭐ **An unknown request is logged** — *`assistant.unsupported` with the raw
phrasing* — ⭐⭐ **and THAT is the product roadmap, written by tenants.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §120 · ⭐⭐⭐ INFOBIP IS PRIMARY  *(owner, T599)*
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 120.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐ **13 capability specs in the register name Twilio; ⛔ only 1 names Infobip.**
*Legacy was written Twilio-first.* ⛔ **If M3 builds from those specs unchanged,
the channel layer ships against the wrong API.**

## 120.1 ⭐⭐ THE RULING

> ⭐⭐⭐ **Infobip and its APIs are the PRIMARY build for everything.**
> ⭐ **Twilio, other carriers and LiveKit are SUPPORTED — ⛔ never the default.**

| ⭐ Layer | Primary | ⭐ Also supported |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **SMS · MMS · RCS** | ⭐ **Infobip** | Twilio · others |
| ⭐⭐ **Voice · IVR · recording** | ⭐ **Infobip** | Twilio · others |
| **Numbers · 10DLC · pooling** | ⭐ **Infobip** | Twilio |
| **WhatsApp** | ⭐ **Infobip** | — |
| ⭐ **Real-time voice AI** | ⭐⭐ **LiveKit** *(a different job — media transport, ⛔ not a carrier)* | self-hosted *(X-197)* |

⭐ **LiveKit is not an alternative to Infobip.** ⛔ *Infobip carries the call;
LiveKit carries the real-time audio pipeline for the agent. ⭐ They sit in series,
not in competition.*

## 120.2 ⭐⭐ WHAT THIS MEANS ARCHITECTURALLY

⭐ **R27 already ruled the shape: `MessagingProvider` and `VoiceProvider` seams.**
⛔ *So this is not "hardcode Infobip" — it is:*

☐ ⭐⭐ **Build the seam to Infobip's API shape** — *webhook signatures, delivery
receipts, error codes, number formats*
☐ ⭐ **Every other carrier adapts INTO that shape** — ⛔ *not the reverse*
☐ ⭐⭐ **The default provider row in `platform_settings` is `infobip`** — ⛔ *and
the roster is data, never code* *(§43.4)*
☐ ⭐ **Existing code already agrees** — `InfobipClient` 495 · `InfobipVoiceProvider`
411 · webhooks at `/webhooks/infobip/voice`, `/inbound`, `/delivery`

## 120.3 ⭐ THE 13 TWILIO CAPABILITIES — REWRITTEN, ⛔ NOT DROPPED

⭐ **Each keeps its mechanism and swaps its provider.** *"Provisions a real Twilio
number"* → ⭐⭐ *"provisions a real Infobip number."* ⛔ **The capability is the
behaviour, never the vendor.**

⚠️ ⭐ **One that needs real care: `Twilio Power-Dialing`.** ⭐⭐ *Infobip's
outbound-calling API differs from Twilio's dialer — the capability survives, the
implementation is not a find-and-replace.*

## 120.4 ⭐ WHAT M3 INHERITS

⭐⭐ **M3 (channels) builds against Infobip's actual API**, with:
☐ ⭐ **`SendDriver` as the seam** *(already exists — 124 lines)*
☐ ⭐⭐ **Infobip webhook signature verification** — ⛔ *no-oracle errors*
☐ ⭐ **Delivery receipts mapped to SENT / DELIVERED** *(§108.2)*
☐ ⭐⭐ **Infobip's segment counting as the billing truth** — ⛔ *1 credit = 1
segment is only honest if the count comes from the carrier*

## 120.5 ACCEPTANCE — §120

☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Infobip primary for SMS · MMS · RCS · voice · numbers · WhatsApp**
☐ ⭐ **LiveKit is media transport, ⛔ not a carrier — they sit in series**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Build the seam to INFOBIP's shape; ⛔ others adapt into it**
☐ ⭐ Provider roster stays DATA in `platform_settings`
☐ ⭐ **13 Twilio capabilities rewritten, ⛔ none dropped**
☐ ⚠️ **Power-Dialing needs real work — ⛔ not a find-and-replace**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Infobip's segment count is the billing truth**

**All seven ✅ — §120 COMPLETE.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §121 · ⭐⭐⭐ THE CARRIER ROSTER  *(owner, T600)*
⭐ **Infobip primary · seven supported · ⛔ Twilio is not among them**
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 121.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐ **A lowest-common-denominator seam.** ⛔ *If `SendDriver` only exposes what ALL
eight carriers share, you lose Bandwidth's E911, Telnyx's latency and Sinch's
RCS — ⭐ and the seam becomes the reason the product is mediocre.*

## 121.1 ⭐⭐ THE ROSTER

| ⭐ Carrier | Strength | ⭐⭐ Route to it when |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **INFOBIP** | ⭐ **PRIMARY — everything** | default for all traffic |
| ⭐⭐ **Telnyx** | ⭐ **owns its IP network · lowest latency · 30–50% under Twilio** | ⭐⭐ **real-time voice agents · SIP · streaming LLM pipelines** |
| ⭐⭐ **Bandwidth** | ⭐ **tier-1 nationwide · powers Zoom, Google Voice, Teams** | ⭐⭐ **toll-free origination · call quality at scale** *(⛔ E911 removed T602)* |
| ⭐ **Sinch** | owns Inteliquent · strongest global carrier relationships | ⭐ **RCS · international · verification** |
| ⭐ **Plivo** | ⭐ **35–40% under Twilio, near-identical API** | ⭐ **bulk SMS where cost dominates** |
| **Vonage** | Ericsson-backed · fastest signup-to-send | WhatsApp · video · Verify |
| **Bird** *(MessageBird)* | omnichannel flows and inbox | conversational marketing |
| **SignalWire** | ⭐ **built by the FreeSWITCH authors** | advanced telephony · video rooms |

⛔ **Twilio is NOT on the roster.** ⭐ *Every carrier here is chosen against it on
cost, latency or network ownership.*

## 121.2 ⭐⭐⭐ THE SEAM DECLARES CAPABILITIES, ⛔ NOT JUST METHODS

⭐ **Same pattern as the AI model roster** *(§43.4)* — ⭐⭐ **already proven.**

```yaml
  ⭐ provider: telnyx
    supports: [sms, mms, voice, sip, webrtc, lookup]
    ⛔ lacks:  [e911, rcs]
    ⭐⭐ latency_p50_ms: 40
    cost: { sms_segment: …, voice_minute: … }   ⭐ from a real invoice, never typed
```

⭐⭐ **Routing is by CAPABILITY, then cost, then latency:**

| ⭐ Traffic | Routes to |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Real-time voice agent** | ⭐ **lowest `latency_p50_ms` that supports `webrtc`** → *Telnyx* |
| ⭐ **Toll-free origination · quality at scale** | → *Bandwidth* |
| **Bulk marketing SMS** | ⭐ lowest `sms_segment` cost → *Plivo* |
| **RCS** | `rcs` capability → *Sinch* |
| **Everything else** | ⭐ **Infobip** |

⛔ **A tenant never chooses a carrier.** ⭐⭐ *They choose an outcome; the roster
resolves it.*

## 121.3 ⭐⭐ WHY THIS MATTERS TO THE MARGIN

⭐ **Voice is priced at 7¢/minute, full minutes.** ⛔ *Nobody has measured Infobip's
real per-minute cost.*
⭐⭐ **Telnyx at 30–50% under Twilio is the margin hedge** — ⛔ *if Infobip lands
at 6¢, the voice product is broken; ⭐ if Telnyx lands at 3¢, it is a 57% margin.*
⭐ **The roster makes that a settings change, ⛔ never a rebuild.**

## 121.4 ⭐ WHAT FAILOVER LOOKS LIKE

```
  ⭐⭐ ① same carrier, next account      ← rate limit · billing hold *(§101.2)*
  ⭐ ② next carrier WITH the capability  ⛔ never one that lacks it
  ③ escalate: pay more for the same outcome
  ⛔ ④ degrade honestly and alert — never fail silently
```

⚠️ ⭐⭐ **Rung ② is the one with teeth:** ⛔ *failing an RCS-required send over to
a carrier without RCS silently downgrades it — ⭐ and the tenant paid for RCS.*

## 121.5 ⭐ WHAT M3 INHERITS

☐ ⭐⭐ **Build `SendDriver` and `VoiceProvider` to INFOBIP's shape**
☐ ⭐ **Seven adapters conform INTO it** — ⛔ never the reverse
☐ ⭐⭐ **Each declares `supports` / `lacks` / `latency` / `cost`** — ⛔ **as DATA**
☐ ⭐ **Cost fields populate from real invoices** *(testing phase T1)*
☐ ⭐⭐ **Routing is capability-first, ⛔ cost-second**
☐ ⛔ **Twilio ships as an adapter only if a tenant demands it** — not built now

## 121.6 ACCEPTANCE — §121

☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Infobip primary · 7 supported · ⛔ Twilio off the roster**
☐ ⭐⭐ **The seam declares CAPABILITIES — ⛔ lowest-common-denominator rejected**
☐ ⭐ Telnyx for real-time voice · ⭐⭐ **Bandwidth for E911** · Plivo for bulk cost · Sinch for RCS
☐ ⭐ **A tenant never picks a carrier — they pick an outcome**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Telnyx is the voice-margin hedge if Infobip is expensive**
☐ ⛔ **Failover never crosses to a carrier lacking the required capability**

**All six ✅ — §121 COMPLETE.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §122 · ⭐⭐⭐ BUILD ALL EIGHT ADAPTERS NOW  *(owner, T601)*
⭐ **One active, seven dormant. ⛔ The code is never touched again.**
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 122.0 ⭐⭐ THE RULING

> ⭐⭐⭐ **Build every carrier's adapter into the telephony engine NOW, while the
> seam is being written. ⛔ Only Infobip carries credentials.**

⭐ **This answers my own least-confident flag.** ⛔ *Capability-first routing is
over-engineering only if you retrofit seven adapters later.* ⭐⭐ **Writing all
eight in one pass costs one pass. Retrofitting costs eight — each against a seam
that has drifted since.**

| ⭐ Status | Carriers | Means |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **ACTIVE** | **Infobip** | credentials present, ⭐ carrying all traffic |
| ⭐ **DORMANT** | Telnyx · Bandwidth · Sinch · Plivo · Vonage · Bird · SignalWire | ⭐⭐ **adapter written and tested · ⛔ no credentials · zero traffic** |

⭐⭐⭐ **Activation = paste credentials + flip one row. ⛔ No deploy, no code, no
migration.**

## 122.1 ⛔⛔ DORMANT ≠ UNTESTED — the rule that makes this real

> ⭐⭐ **A dormant adapter is tested against its carrier's SANDBOX.**

⛔ **Seven adapters that have never run is seven surprises on the day you need
one** — ⭐ *and you need one on the day the primary is down, which is the worst
possible moment to discover a bug.*

☐ ⭐ **Every carrier's free sandbox account is created now** — *credentials stored
in the vault, ⛔ marked `sandbox`*
☐ ⭐⭐ **Each adapter's contract test runs against its own sandbox in CI**
☐ ⛔ **A dormant adapter that fails its sandbox test fails the build** — *the
same as an active one*
☐ ⭐ **`goaiez:carrier:health` reports all eight** — ⭐⭐ *active AND dormant*

## 122.2 ⭐⭐ WHAT THE ADAPTER ACTUALLY NORMALISES

⭐ **This is where the real work is. ⛔ Each carrier differs in ways that break
silently:**

| ⭐ Dimension | ⛔ Why it bites |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Webhook signature scheme** | *all eight differ — HMAC variants, header names, body encoding.* ⛔ **A wrong verification either rejects real traffic or accepts forged traffic** |
| ⭐⭐ **Delivery receipt shape** | *SENT · DELIVERED · FAILED map differently.* ⛔ **§108.2 splits counts on this** |
| ⭐ **Error codes** | *a retryable error on one is terminal on another* |
| ⭐⭐ **Segment counting** | ⛔ **1 credit = 1 segment is only honest if the CARRIER supplies the count** |
| **Number format** | E.164 mostly, ⭐ with edge cases in short codes and alphanumeric senders |
| ⭐ **Media (MMS) handling** | *URL vs upload vs base64* |
| **Rate-limit semantics** | *429 shapes and retry-after headers differ* |

⭐⭐⭐ **The seam's job is to make these seven differences invisible upstream.**
⛔ *If any of them leaks into a module, the abstraction has already failed.*

## 122.3 ⭐ THE SHAPE

```
  ⭐⭐ app/Services/Telephony/
     ⭐ Contracts/  MessagingProvider · VoiceProvider · NumberProvider
     Adapters/   InfobipAdapter ⭐ACTIVE
                 TelnyxAdapter · BandwidthAdapter · SinchAdapter
                 PlivoAdapter · VonageAdapter · BirdAdapter
                 SignalWireAdapter          ⛔ all DORMANT
     ⭐ Roster/     CarrierRoster (supports · lacks · latency · cost · status)
     ⭐⭐ Routing/    CapabilityRouter · FailoverLadder
     Normalisers/ SignatureVerifier · ReceiptMapper · ErrorMapper · SegmentCounter
```

## 122.4 ⭐⭐ THE SAME RULING APPLIES BEYOND CARRIERS

⭐ **The pattern generalises, and it is worth stating once:**

| Layer | ⭐ Build all now |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Carriers** | 8 adapters *(this ruling)* |
| ⭐ **AI providers** | *§43.4's roster — same shape, already ruled* |
| ⭐ **Payment gateways** | Authorize.Net ⭐ACTIVE · Stripe ⭐ACTIVE · ⛔ others dormant |
| **Email** | SES ACTIVE · others dormant |

⛔ **A provider that has to be added later is a code change under time pressure.**
⭐⭐ **A provider that is already written is a settings change on a calm Tuesday.**

## 122.5 ACCEPTANCE — §122

☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **All 8 carrier adapters written in the M3 pass** — ⛔ not later
☐ ⭐ **Infobip ACTIVE · 7 DORMANT** *(no credentials, zero traffic)*
☐ ⭐⭐ **Activation = credentials + one row. ⛔ No deploy**
☐ ⛔⛔ **DORMANT ≠ UNTESTED — every adapter has a sandbox contract test in CI**
☐ ⭐ **A dormant adapter failing its sandbox test FAILS THE BUILD**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Seven normalisers: signature · receipt · error · segment · number · media · rate-limit**
☐ ⭐ **`goaiez:carrier:health` reports all eight**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Pattern generalises to AI, payments and email** — ⛔ *build the adapter while the seam is warm*

**All eight ✅ — §122 COMPLETE.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §123 · ⛔ E911 REMOVED  *(owner, T602)*
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 123.1 ⭐ THE RULING

> ⛔⛔ **E911 is OUT OF SCOPE. ⭐ If a carrier requires it, that requirement is
> declined, not met.**

⭐ **And there is a real reason it is safe, worth stating once:**

| ⭐ What we are | ⛔ What we are NOT |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **A LAYER in front of their phone** — *a tracking and answering number that forwards to their real line* | ⛔ **their primary phone service** |
| ⭐ **Inbound-first** — *customers call the business* | ⛔ *a replacement line someone would dial 911 from* |
| ⭐ **Their existing mobile or landline handles emergencies** | ⛔ *we never sit between a person and 911* |

⭐⭐ **A tenant's real phone is untouched.** ⛔ *We add a number in front of it; we
never take one away.*

## 123.2 ⚠️ THE ONE BOUNDARY THAT WOULD CHANGE THIS

⭐ **If a tenant ever PORTS their main business number to us and uses it as their
only line, the picture changes.** ⛔ *That is a different product.*

☐ ⭐⭐ **Porting a tenant's primary number is NOT offered** — *§43.1's pool and
their own 10DLC sit alongside their existing line, ⛔ never replacing it*
☐ ⭐ **If porting is ever offered, E911 returns to scope** — ⭐⭐ **and this
section is the trigger to revisit it**

## 123.3 ⭐ WHAT CHANGES ON THE ROSTER

⭐ **Bandwidth stays** — ⛔ *its E911 strength is no longer why.* ⭐⭐ **It earns
its place on tier-1 network quality and toll-free origination.**
⭐ **`e911` is removed from every `supports` / `lacks` declaration.**
⭐⭐ **The failover ladder's rung ② now bites on RCS instead** — ⛔ *silently
downgrading an RCS send to SMS when the tenant paid for RCS.*

## 123.4 ACCEPTANCE — §123

☐ ⛔⛔ **E911 out of scope** — *a carrier requiring it is declined*
☐ ⭐⭐ **The reason: we are a LAYER, ⛔ never their primary line**
☐ ⭐ **Bandwidth stays for tier-1 quality and toll-free**
☐ ⚠️ ⭐ **Porting a primary number is NOT offered — ⛔ if it ever is, E911 returns**
☐ ⭐ `e911` stripped from all capability declarations

**All five ✅ — §123 COMPLETE.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §124 · ⭐⭐⭐ M3a — THE TELEPHONY ENGINE  *(T605 · turn 3 of 36)* *(historical count — see §156.6)*
⛔ **The engine only. Channel modules are M3b.**
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 124.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐⭐ **A carrier difference leaking upstream.** ⛔ *If `C-Sms` ever has to know
whether it is talking to Infobip or Telnyx, the abstraction has already failed —
and every module written after it inherits the leak.*

⭐ **The engine's only job: make eight carriers indistinguishable to everything
above it.**

---

## 124.1 ⭐⭐ THE TELEPHONY ROUTER

**① CAPABILITIES FOLDED — 11**
⭐ **Carrier Route Detection** · ⭐⭐ **Carrier Rate Shopping** · **Local Caller
ID** · **Local Presence** · ⭐ **Sticky Routing** *(a conversation keeps its
carrier)* · **Multi-Provider Sync** · **Provider Waterfall** · ⭐ **Cost Routing
Engine** · **Load Balancing** · **Multi-Region Redundancy** · **Number Reputation
Monitoring**.

**② WIZARD** ⛔ **none — ⭐ a tenant never chooses a carrier, they choose an
outcome**
**③ AUTOPILOT** ⭐⭐ *routes every send and every call, ⛔ with no configuration
ever asked of anyone*
**④ EMITS** `carrier.selected` · `carrier.failed_over` · `carrier.degraded`
**④ CONSUMES** `send.requested` · `call.requested` · `number.needed`
**⑤ AI-CORE** ⛔ **none — ⭐ the router is deterministic.** *An LLM in the send
path is latency and non-determinism where neither is wanted*

### ⭐⭐⭐ 124.1.1 THE SELECTION ORDER

```
  ⭐ ① CAPABILITY   ⛔ does it support what this send REQUIRES? (rcs · mms · sip · webrtc)
  ⭐ ② STICKINESS   ⭐⭐ is this conversation already on a carrier? → KEEP IT
  ③ HEALTH         is it currently degraded?
  ⭐ ④ LATENCY      for voice: lowest p50 wins
  ⑤ COST           for bulk: lowest per-unit wins
  ⭐⭐ ⑥ DEFAULT     Infobip
```

⭐⭐ **Step ② is the one nobody expects and it matters most.** ⛔ *A customer
mid-conversation who suddenly receives a message from a different number thinks
they are being spammed — **stickiness is a trust property, not an optimisation.***

---

## 124.2 ⭐⭐ THE EIGHT ADAPTERS

⭐ **One contract, eight implementations. ⛔ Seven dormant, all tested.**

```php
  interface CarrierAdapter {
    ⭐ send(SendPermit $p, Message $m): CarrierReceipt;
    call(CallRequest $r): CarrierCall;
    provisionNumber(Area $a): PhoneNumber;
    ⭐⭐ verifyWebhook(Request $r): bool;   ⛔ each scheme differs
    capabilities(): CapabilitySet;
    healthCheck(): CarrierHealth;
  }
```

| Adapter | Status | ⭐ Earns its place on |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Infobip** | **ACTIVE** | ⭐ everything — the default |
| **Telnyx** | DORMANT | ⭐⭐ **voice latency · SIP · ⭐ the margin hedge** |
| **Bandwidth** | DORMANT | toll-free origination · tier-1 quality |
| **Sinch** | DORMANT | ⭐ **RCS · global reach** |
| **Plivo** | DORMANT | ⭐ bulk SMS cost |
| **Vonage** | DORMANT | WhatsApp · Verify |
| **Bird** | DORMANT | omnichannel flows |
| **SignalWire** | DORMANT | advanced telephony · video |

☐ ⭐⭐ **Each ships a sandbox contract test in CI** — ⛔ **a dormant adapter that
fails it FAILS THE BUILD**
☐ ⭐ **Activation = credentials + one row.** ⛔ No deploy

---

## 124.3 ⭐⭐⭐ THE SEVEN NORMALISERS — ⛔ where the real work is

| # | Normaliser | ⭐ What it hides · ⛔ what happens without it |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **1** | **SignatureVerifier** | *HMAC variants, header names, body encoding — all eight differ.* ⛔⛔ **Wrong = forged traffic accepted or real traffic rejected** |
| ⭐⭐ **2** | **ReceiptMapper** | *→ QUEUED · SENT · DELIVERED · FAILED · UNKNOWN.* ⛔ **§108.2 splits every count on this** |
| ⭐ **3** | **ErrorMapper** | ⛔ *retryable on one carrier is terminal on another — ⭐ a wrong call either loops forever or drops a real message* |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **4** | **SegmentCounter** | ⛔⛔ **"1 credit = 1 segment" is only honest if the CARRIER supplies the count.** ⭐ *Our own character math is a guess — and one emoji flips GSM-7 to UCS-2* |
| ⭐ **5** | **NumberFormatter** | E.164, short codes, ⭐ alphanumeric senders *(demo numbers)* |
| **6** | **MediaHandler** | *MMS as URL vs upload vs base64* |
| ⭐ **7** | **RateLimitReader** | *429 shapes and `retry-after` semantics differ* — ⭐ **feeds the leaky bucket** |

⭐⭐ **Normaliser 4 is a BILLING correctness issue, not a formatting one.** ⛔
*Every segment we miscount is money.*

---

## 124.4 ⭐⭐ THE FAILOVER LADDER

```
  ⭐⭐ ① SAME CARRIER, NEXT ACCOUNT   ← rate limit · billing hold · revoked key
                                       ⭐ identical behaviour, identical cost
  ⭐ ② NEXT CARRIER **WITH THE CAPABILITY**
                                       ⛔ NEVER one that lacks it
  ③ ESCALATE                          pay more for the same outcome
  ⛔ ④ DEGRADE HONESTLY + ALERT        ⛔ never fail silently
```

⚠️ ⭐⭐ **Rung ② has the teeth:** ⛔ *silently downgrading an RCS send to SMS
when the tenant paid for RCS is a refund conversation, not a failover.*

☐ ⭐ **A carrier is marked COLD for a window on a 429** — ⛔ *not condemned*
☐ ⭐⭐ **Voice fails over on ELAPSED MILLISECONDS**, ⛔ not only on error *(§43.4)*
☐ ⭐ **Every hop writes an `ActionInvocation`** — ⭐⭐ *so EXPLAIN can answer
"why did this text come from a different number?"*
☐ ⛔ **Rung ④ alerts the operator, ⭐ never the tenant** *(an outage is ours)*

---

## 124.5 ⭐ THE SHAPE

```
  app/Services/Telephony/
    Contracts/    CarrierAdapter · MessagingProvider · VoiceProvider · NumberProvider
    ⭐ Adapters/     Infobip ⭐ACTIVE · Telnyx · Bandwidth · Sinch
                  Plivo · Vonage · Bird · SignalWire      ⛔ 7 DORMANT
    ⭐ Roster/       CarrierRoster  (supports · lacks · latency · cost · status)
    ⭐⭐ Routing/     CapabilityRouter · StickyBinding · FailoverLadder
    ⭐⭐ Normalisers/ SignatureVerifier · ReceiptMapper · ErrorMapper
                  SegmentCounter · NumberFormatter · MediaHandler · RateLimitReader
    Health/       CarrierHealth · goaiez:carrier:health
```

⭐ **`@module M3a` · `@visibility public`: `CarrierAdapter` + `CapabilityRouter`
ONLY.** ⛔ **Every adapter and every normaliser is `internal`** — *§95's rule, and
it is what keeps the leak impossible.*

## 124.6 ACCEPTANCE — M3a

☐ ⭐⭐ **Selection order: capability → ⭐ STICKINESS → health → latency → cost → Infobip**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Stickiness is a TRUST property** — ⛔ *a mid-conversation number change reads as spam*
☐ ⭐ **8 adapters, one contract; ⛔ 7 dormant, all sandbox-tested in CI**
☐ ⭐⭐ **7 normalisers** — ⭐⭐⭐ **SegmentCounter is a BILLING correctness issue**
☐ ⭐ **Failover: same account → ⛔ capability-matched carrier → escalate → honest degrade**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Voice fails over on ELAPSED MS**; every hop writes an `ActionInvocation`
☐ ⛔ **Only `CarrierAdapter` and `CapabilityRouter` are public** — everything else internal
☐ ⛔ **No wizard, no tenant autopilot, ⭐ no LLM in the send path**

**All eight ✅ — §124 COMPLETE · ⭐ M3a · 3 of 36.**

☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **COMPOSE-TIME MODERATION ONLY.** ⭐⭐ **The send path executes; it does
not think.** ⛔ *All linting, moderation and compliance happen before the message

message must fire.*

## 126.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐⭐ **Latency.** ⛔ *A voice agent that pauses for 1.2 seconds is not a slow

## 126.1 ⭐⭐ M3b RULINGS — LOCKED

structurally impossible rather than a thing to remember.**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Spintax compiles BEFORE `SegmentCounter`.** ⭐ *The tenant is warned on
the LONGEST possible resolution.* ⛔ *Otherwise a `{greeting}` variant silently
turns a 1-segment text into 2 and doubles the bill.*
☐ ⭐ **Default outbound SMS throttle: 250/day on a new 10DLC brand**, scaling with
account age and a near-zero complaint rate.

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §133 · ⭐⭐⭐ EMAIL · AGENCY MERCHANT · INVOICING  *(owner, T622)*
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 133.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐⭐ **Three billing models in one platform.** ⛔ *Card-on-file subscription,
agency-as-merchant, and invoice-with-terms each have different failure modes — and
a tenant who ends up in two of them at once gets billed twice or not at all.*

---

## 133.1 ⭐⭐⭐ EMAIL PRICING — ⛔ REPLACES §108.2

| ⭐ Item | Price |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Connection: IMAP · POP · OAuth Google · OAuth Microsoft · SES** | ⭐⭐⭐ **FREE** |
| ⭐ **Sending** | ⭐⭐ **$10 per 1,000** ⛔ *(was $20 — halved)* |
| ⭐⭐ **Volume tier** | ⭐⭐⭐ **100,000 for $500** — *$5 per 1,000, ⭐ a 50% break* |

⛔ **The CONNECTION is free; the SENDING is metered.** ⭐ *A tenant may wire up
five inboxes and pay nothing until a message leaves.*

⚠️ ⭐ **This is the first volume break in the platform.** ⛔ *SMS has no
equivalent — $50/1,000 is flat at every volume.* ⭐⭐ **Worth deciding
deliberately whether SMS should follow, ⛔ or whether email is different because
our marginal cost drops with volume and SMS's does not.**

---

## 133.2 ⭐⭐ AGENCY ECONOMICS — CONFIRMED AND EXTENDED

| ⭐ Item | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Platform fee** | **$497/month, unlimited clients** |
| ⭐ **Usage discount** | **40% off everything** |
| ⭐⭐ **Voice** | ⭐ **25% off** *(⛔ nearer cost — 7¢ → 5.25¢)* |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **Included usage** | ⛔ **ZERO. An agency account carries no allowance** |
| ⭐ **How they operate** | ⭐⭐ **minimum top-ups per client** |

### ⭐⭐⭐ 133.2.1 TWO WAYS AN AGENCY PAYS

```
  ⭐ MODE A · AGENCY ABSORBS
     the agency buys all top-ups at 40% off and bills the client whatever it likes
       ⛔ we never see the client's card

  ⭐⭐ MODE B · DISCOUNT EXTENDED
     ⭐ the agency extends its discount to the client
     ⭐⭐ WE top up at the DISCOUNTED rate and bill THE AGENCY'S CARD for their clients
       ⛔ the agency still owns the relationship; ⭐ we do the mechanics
```

⭐⭐ **In both modes the discount belongs to the agency** *(§91)*. ⛔ *The
difference is who holds the card and who does the arithmetic.*

---

## 133.3 ⭐⭐⭐ AGENCY-AS-MERCHANT — ⛔ GENUINELY NEW

> ⭐⭐ **An agency connects its OWN Stripe or Authorize.Net merchant account and
> charges its clients directly — ⭐ monthly fee AND usage.**

| ⭐ What we provide | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Stripe Connect + Authorize.Net multi-merchant** | *the agency's own account, ⛔ never ours* |
| ⭐ **Per-client subscription billing** | the agency sets the price |
| ⭐⭐ **Usage pass-through** | ⭐ **at the agency's markup, ⛔ never our wholesale rate** |
| ⭐ **Dunning on their behalf** | ⭐⭐ *their branding, their timeline* |
| ⭐ **Payout and reconciliation** | ⭐ *what they charged vs what they owe us* |

⭐⭐⭐ **THE VISIBILITY RULE HOLDS** *(§17.5)*: ⭐ **the agency sees cost, markup
and margin. ⛔ Their client sees the agency's price ONLY — never our wholesale
rate.**

⚠️ ⭐⭐ **This is substantial enough to question its home.** ⭐ *It folds into
`X-112 AgencyConsole` + `C-Billing` for now.* ⛔ **If it needs its own number it
mints as X-198 through the warden — ⭐ flagged, not decided.**

---

## 133.4 ⭐⭐⭐ INVOICING WITH TERMS — ⛔ ALSO NEW

> ⭐⭐ **For large commercial clients: credit limits, payment terms, and a card on
> file that catches the overflow.**

⭐ **Available to US and to AGENCIES.**

| ⭐ Mechanic | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Credit limit** | per account, set by us or by the agency |
| ⭐ **Terms** | net 15 · net 30 · net 60 |
| ⭐⭐ **Invoice generation** | monthly, ⭐ *itemised by plan and by meter* |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **⛔ EXCEEDING THE LIMIT** | ⭐ **the card on file continues billing** — ⛔ **service NEVER stops** |
| ⭐ **They may pay the invoice** | ⭐⭐ *and the card charge reverses against it* |

⭐⭐⭐ **THE OVERFLOW RULE IS THE WHOLE POINT:** ⛔ *A commercial client on net-30
who hits their limit mid-month does not lose their phone service.* ⭐ **The card
absorbs it, the invoice reconciles later, and nobody has a bad Tuesday.**

### ⚠️ 133.4.1 ⛔ THIS IS NOT A PAYMENT PLAN

⭐ **T591 killed `Dynamic Payment Plans` and `Milestone Billing`** — *splitting one
invoice into installments.* ⛔ **That kill stands.**
⭐⭐ **Invoicing with terms is a different thing entirely:** ⭐ *a monthly bill to
a commercial account with agreed terms, ⛔ not a consumer paying £5,000 over
three months.*

---

## 133.5 ⭐ AFFILIATE — CONFIRMED

⭐⭐ **40% of the PLAN, for life, while the client pays.** ⛔ **Nothing on usage.**
⭐ *£0 while paused, resuming on return* *(§48A)*.

---

## 133.6 ⭐⭐ THE THREE BILLING MODELS — ⛔ a tenant is in exactly ONE

| Model | Who | ⭐ Payment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐ **DIRECT** | most tenants | card on file, ⭐ auto top-up |
| ⭐⭐ **AGENCY-BILLED** | an agency's clients | ⭐ *the agency's card or the agency's merchant account* |
| ⭐⭐ **INVOICED** | large commercial | ⭐ **terms + a card for overflow** |

⛔⛔ **A tenant is in exactly one model at a time.** ⭐ *Moving between them is an
explicit action with a clean cutover, ⛔ never an overlap — that is how double-
billing happens.*

## 133.7 ACCEPTANCE — §133

☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Email connection FREE** *(IMAP · POP · OAuth Google · OAuth Microsoft · SES)*
☐ ⭐⭐ **Sending $10/1,000** ⛔ *(was $20)* · ⭐⭐⭐ **100,000 for $500**
☐ ⚠️ ⭐ **First volume break in the platform** — ⛔ *SMS has none; decide deliberately*

☐ ⭐⭐ **Two payment modes: agency absorbs, ⭐ or discount extended and we bill the agency's card**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **AGENCY-AS-MERCHANT — their own Stripe/Authorize.Net, ⛔ their client never sees our wholesale**
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Invoicing with credit limits and terms; ⛔ EXCEEDING IT NEVER STOPS SERVICE — the card absorbs it**
☐ ⚠️ **Invoicing ≠ payment plans** — ⛔ *T591's kill of installments stands*
☐ ⭐ **Affiliate 40% of PLAN for life; ⛔ nothing on usage**
☐ ⛔⛔ **A tenant is in exactly ONE billing model** — ⭐ *overlap is how double-billing happens*

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §134 · ⭐⭐⭐ THE FOURTH BILLING RELATIONSHIP + THE SITE AS INTEGRATION  *(owner, T623)*
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 134.0 ⛔ WHAT KILLS THIS

⭐⭐ **Building the merchant layer three times.** ⛔ *We are about to give
Stripe/Authorize.Net connectivity to an agency (§133.3), to a tenant's website,
and to a tenant's invoices — ⭐ and if those are three implementations, they will
drift and two of them will be wrong.*

## 134.1 ⭐⭐⭐ THERE ARE FOUR BILLING RELATIONSHIPS, ⛔ NOT THREE

| # | Who bills whom | ⭐ Money lands in |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ⭐ **1** | **GOAIEZ → tenant** | ⭐ our account |
| **2** | **GOAIEZ → agency** | our account |
| ⭐⭐ **3** | **agency → their client** *(§133.3)* | ⭐ **the AGENCY's merchant account** |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **4** | ⭐⭐ **TENANT → THEIR CUSTOMER** *(NEW)* | ⭐⭐⭐ **the TENANT's merchant account** |

⛔⛔ **Relationship 4 is categorically different: we are not billing anyone.**
⭐⭐ **We are the plumbing a plumber uses to take £2,400 for a boiler.**

## 134.2 ⭐⭐⭐ ONE MODULE, THREE CONSUMERS — ⛔ not three modules

> ⭐⭐ **`MerchantConnect` is built ONCE and consumed by us, by agencies and by
> tenants.**

| ⭐ Capability | Used by |
| :--- | :--- |
| Connect Stripe / Authorize.Net | ⭐ agency · tenant |
| Charge a card | all three |
| ⭐ **Subscription billing** | ⭐⭐ *agency→client · **tenant→customer (memberships)*** |
| ⭐⭐ **Invoice with terms** *(§133.4)* | ⭐ **us · agency · ⭐⭐ tenant** |
| Payment links | ⭐ all three |
| Dunning | ⭐ *each under their own branding* |
| Reconciliation | all three |

⭐⭐⭐ **The realisation: §133.4's invoicing with credit limits and terms is not
just OUR feature.** ⛔ *A plumber invoicing a property-management company on net-30
needs exactly the same mechanism — ⭐ credit limit, terms, and a card on file that
catches the overflow so the work never stops.*

⚠️ ⭐ **PCI: the card NEVER touches our page.** ⭐⭐ **Stripe Elements and
Authorize.Net Accept.js keep every merchant out of our scope** *(R91's rule,
applied three times).*

## 134.3 ⭐ COMMERCE SCOPE — ⛔ the kill list still binds

⛔ **"Mini-Shopify" is on the kill list and stays there.** ⭐ **What a trade
actually needs:**

☐ ⭐⭐ **Pay this invoice** *(the big one)*
☐ ⭐ **Book and pay a deposit**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Buy a membership or service plan** *(X-165 — recurring, the best revenue
a trade has)*
☐ ⭐ **A handful of products** — *filters, parts, a callout fee*
☐ ⛔ **NOT: inventory-driven retail, variants, shipping matrices, tax nexus**

---

## 134.4 ⭐⭐⭐ THE SITE IS THE INTEGRATION TEST — ⛔ not a builder turn

⭐⭐ **You are right to defer it. ⛔ But the reason matters more than the timing.**

> ⭐⭐⭐ **The website is where the entire platform becomes VISIBLE TO THE PUBLIC.
> ⛔ A module that does not surface on the site is invisible to the tenant's
> customers — which means it may as well not exist.**

```
  ⭐ ONE PAGE, and everything must land on it:
     X-102 chat widget · X-110 pixel · X-155 forms · X-108 booking
     C-Reviews · ⭐⭐ X-163 prices · X-117 cart · X-137 DNI

```

for eleven modules at once.**

## 134.5 ⭐⭐⭐ THE ONE THING THAT MUST HAPPEN NOW, ⛔ NOT AT M20

⚠️ **THE RISK:** ⛔ *every module specced between now and M20 is being designed
without knowing what the site needs from it.* ⭐ **At M20 we will find modules
that have no way to render.**

> ⭐⭐⭐ **THE FIX — add `@renders` to the module contract, TODAY.**

```php
  /**
   *
   * @visibility public
   * ⭐⭐ @renders price_table · price_range · callout_fee_line
   */
```

| ⭐ Why now | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **It costs one line per module while we are already writing them** | |
| ⛔ **At M20 it is a re-open of every module** | ⭐ *and law 127 has no room for that* |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **`doctor` can then check it** | ⛔ *a public module with nothing to render is either internal or incomplete* |
| ⭐ **And the site builder gets a MANIFEST, not a guess** | ⭐⭐ *it asks the registry "what can render?" and lays out what exists* |

⭐⭐ **Retroactive: M1–M11's modules get `@renders` in the B1 annotation pass
(I8)** — ⛔ *one sweep, not eleven re-opens.*

## 134.6 ⭐⭐ AND THE SITE INHERITS THE ALWAYS-ON LOOP

⭐ **§110 already ruled it:** ⭐⭐ **design forks, runtime does not** · the AI

⭐ **Commerce inherits it too** — ⛔ *but with a harder line:* ⭐⭐ **the optimiser
may test a product image or a button label. ⛔ It may NEVER test a price.**

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# §137 · ⭐⭐⭐ QUIET HOURS APPLY TO MARKETING ONLY  *(owner, T628)*
⛔ **This SIMPLIFIES the architecture. It does not extend it.**
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

## 137.1 ⭐⭐⭐ THE LAW

> ⭐⭐ **QUIET HOURS GATE MARKETING. ⛔ NOTHING ELSE.**

| ⭐ EXEMPT — sends at any hour | Why |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⭐⭐ **Anything involving a client TRANSACTION** | *invoice · receipt · payment link · payment failed · refund* |
| ⭐⭐⭐ **Anything the CUSTOMER INITIATED** | ⭐ *web chat · a call · a form · an inbound text — **they started it*** |
| ⭐⭐ **Client NOTIFICATIONS** | *alerts to the tenant's own staff* |
| ⭐ **Account class** | *dunning · wind-down · service notices* |
| ⭐ **Appointment reminders** | *they booked it; the reminder is the service* |
| ⭐ **Missed-call text-back** | ⭐⭐ **they just rang. ⛔ Nothing is more responsive than answering** |

| ⛔ GATED — the daytime window only | |
| :--- | :--- |
| ⛔ **Marketing campaigns** | |
| ⛔ **Reactivation** | ⭐ *outreach they did not initiate* |
| ⛔ **Offers, promotions, upsells** | ⭐ *including one riding inside a receipt* *(R92)* |

## 137.2 ⭐⭐⭐ WHAT THIS REMOVES — ⛔ the 7-day window was a WORKAROUND

⭐ **§110 built a 7-day conversational exemption so replies could send at any
hour.** ⛔⛔ **That mechanism is now unnecessary as a GATE.**

```
  ⛔ BEFORE:  is it within 7 days of their last inbound? → exempt from quiet hours
             ⭐ (a time window doing a classification job)

  ⭐⭐ NOW:    what CLASS is it? → marketing is gated, everything else is not
             ⭐⭐⭐ (the class does its own job)
```

⭐⭐ **The 7-day window SURVIVES — ⛔ but only as a CLASSIFICATION INPUT, never as
a gate:**
☐ ⭐ *They messaged 6 days ago and we reply* → **conversational** → ⭐ exempt
☐ ⭐ *They messaged 8 months ago and we reach out* → ⛔ **marketing** → gated

⭐⭐⭐ **That is cleaner: a time window should decide WHAT something is, ⛔ never
whether a rule applies to it.**

## 137.3 ⭐⭐ WHY IT CANNOT BE ABUSED — ⛔ the defence was already built

⚠️ **The obvious attack: label a marketing blast "transactional" and send at
11pm.**

⭐⭐⭐ **`X-193` classifies from the CALLER, ⛔ NEVER from the content** *(§125.8)*.
⭐ *`X-186 CampaignManager` calling `send()` gets `marketing` class **regardless of
what the message says** — a campaign cannot rename itself into an exemption.*

⭐⭐ **And R92 closes the other hole:** ⛔ *an internal ask carrying an OFFER is
still an offer-carrying message → **marketing class**.* ⭐ *A receipt with a
promotion in it is a promotion.*

## 137.4 ⭐ WHAT STAYS EXACTLY AS IT WAS

☐ ⭐⭐ **STOP is absolute** *(law 108)* — ⛔ *every channel, permanent, no
exemption, no class overrides it*
☐ ⭐ **Quiet hours are a FLOOR on marketing** *(law 109)* — ⭐⭐ **a tenant may
NARROW them, ⛔ never widen**
☐ ⭐⭐ **Pool tenants cannot widen at all** *(§102)* — ⛔ *shared brand reputation*
☐ ⭐ **The recipient's timezone decides, ⛔ not the tenant's** *(§102 waterfall)*
☐ ⭐⭐ **No permit, no send** *(law 110)* — ⭐ *exemption from quiet hours is not
exemption from consent*

⭐⭐⭐ **THAT LAST LINE IS THE ONE TO HOLD:** ⛔ *"exempt from quiet hours" and
"allowed to send" are different questions.* ⭐ **`ConsentService` still decides
whether a message may go at all; ⛔ quiet hours only ever decided WHEN.**

## 137.5 ⭐ WHAT CHANGES IN THE FILES

| § | ⭐ Change |
| :--- | :--- |
| **§102.1** | ⭐ *"web chat, missed-call and alerts do not follow quiet hours"* → ⭐⭐ **generalised: only marketing does** |
| **§110.3 / §126.1** | ⛔ *the 7-day window is no longer a gate* → ⭐ **it is a classification input** |
| ⭐⭐ **§125.8 X-193** | ⭐ **unchanged and now load-bearing** — *the class IS the rule* |
| **Testing J7** | ⭐ *alert 9pm ✅ · dunning 3am ✅ · ⛔ marketing 11pm REFUSED* — ⭐⭐ **add: a receipt at 11pm SENDS; ⛔ a receipt carrying an offer does NOT** |

## 137.6 ACCEPTANCE — §137

☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **Quiet hours gate MARKETING ONLY** — ⛔ transactions, customer-initiated and notifications are exempt
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **The 7-day window is now a CLASSIFICATION INPUT, ⛔ no longer a gate** — *the architecture got simpler*
☐ ⭐⭐ **Reactivation stays MARKETING** — ⭐ *outreach they did not initiate*
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **X-193 classifies from the CALLER, ⛔ never the content** — *a campaign cannot rename itself into an exemption*
☐ ⭐ **R92 holds: an offer inside a receipt is still an offer**
☐ ⭐⭐ **STOP absolute · floor-not-ceiling · pool cannot widen · recipient's timezone** — ⛔ all unchanged
☐ ⭐⭐⭐ **"Exempt from quiet hours" ≠ "allowed to send"** — ⛔ *consent is a separate question and it still governs*

**All seven ✅ — §137 COMPLETE.**
